title: Flow Builder: Panel slide animation + AI wait_for_input fix
summary: Two flow builder fixes: (1) NodePropertyPanel slides in/out with CSS transition instead of always showing, (2) AI wizard system prompt updated to include wait_for_input field for message_text nodes so AI-generated flows correctly pause for user input.

packages.title: NodePropertyPanel slide animation
packages.description: Replace always-visible 256px sidebar with transition-based slide. Width animates from 0 to 256px when node selected, collapses when deselected.

packages.title: AI wizard wait_for_input prompt fix
packages.description: Add wait_for_input to message_text node_registry description in ClaudeWizardService BuildSystemPrompt. Add KRITIK rule for mandatory wait_for_input on info-collecting nodes.

verification_questions.question: Does the panel correctly animate width from 0 to 256px on node select and back to 0 on deselect?
Is the inner content only rendered when a node is selected (no DOM waste)?
Does the AI system prompt clearly instruct setting wait_for_input: true for question-asking message_text nodes?
Are there any regressions in existing NodePropertyPanel behavior (type-specific editors, delete button, label input)?
